PLAN "12-Week Resistance-Forward Program for Body Composition & Insulin Sensitivity"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve insulin sensitivity and body composition via structured resistance training with moderate cardio and nutrition-focused guidance"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper/Lower Crossover A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper/Lower Crossover B":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Posterior Chain & Core":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          ab_wheel 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
  WEEK 2:
    DAY Monday training 60m "Upper/Lower Crossover A (Progression)":
      warmup:
        walk 5 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        push_up 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        front_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        thoracic_extension 60 seconds
        hip FLEXOR stretch 60 seconds
  WEEK 2:
    DAY Wednesday training 60m "Paused Reps & Core":
      warmup:
        cycling 5 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        incline_pull -> not allowed; replace with lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        sumo_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        lat_stretch 60 seconds
        hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
  WEEK 2:
    DAY Friday training 60m "Glutes & Core Focus":
      warmup:
        row 5 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        pallof_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        glute_stretch 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Legs & Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          back_squad 0
        deadlift 4x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
        quad_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Pulling Variations & Core":
        warmup:
          row 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          preacher_curl 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          forearm_stretch 60 seconds

    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy Push/Pull (Progression)":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Legs Emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 per leg rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Core & Conditioning":
        warmup:
          jumping_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          ab_wheel 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          planks 3x45 seconds rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          russian_twist 3x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds

Notes:
- Cardio: include 1-2 short, low-to-moderate intensity sessions per week (5–20 minutes) as needed to support insulin sensitivity without underfuel or overtraining; prefer walking, cycling, or rower at conversational pace.
- RPE guidance: use 7 for most work; adjust to 6–8 by feel if fatigued.
- Progression: aim to add 1–2 reps each week within target rep ranges or raise load when able to hit upper end of reps with good form.
- Frequency: 3 resistance sessions per week (Phase 1), 3–4 per week (Phase 2) with at least 48 hours between same muscle groups.
- Injury prevention: prioritize form, tempo control, and adequate warm-up; avoid maximal loads.
- Nutrition note: ensure adequate daily calories to support training; consider protein target ~1.6–2.2 g/kg body weight, distribute across meals; consult with clinician for cycle-synced training plan if desired.
